تنتهجين (form VII)
# تَنْتَهِجِينَ (tantahijīna) /tan.ta.hi.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# تُنْتَهَجِينَ (tuntahajīna) /tun.ta.ha.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
